Committee: Fiscal Responsibility and Economic Development
Sponsor: Reed
Analyst: John Friedenreich
Date: 03/30/2021
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 338 as introduced would allow the Alabama Innovation Corporation, established pursuant to Senate Bill 339/House Bill 540 of this Regular Legislative session, to provide matching grants, presumably from the Alabama Innovation Fund, also established pursuant to SB339/HB540, to small businesses that have received federal funds under the federal Small Business Innovation Research (SBIR) grant program or the Small Business Technology Transfer (SBTT) grant program. This bill provides that the amount of the matching grant awarded shall not exceed the lesser of 50% of the SBIR or SBTT federal grant award or $100,000 for a Phase I Award and $250,000 for a Phase II Award.
Steve Livingston, Chairperson
Fiscal Responsibility and Economic Development
